name: Sodium 2-ethylhexanoate
description: Sodium 2-ethylhexanoate (CAS 19766-89-3 ) is the sodium salt of 2-ethylhexanoic acid, supplied primarily as a catalyst and drying promoter for industrial coating and polymer systems. It functions as a metal-free carboxylate catalyst, offering an alternative to heavy-metal-based driers and cure accelerators across multiple industrial sectors. In coatings and alkyd resin systems, it acts as a drying catalyst. This product serves as a co-drier, accelerating oxidative crosslinking in solvent-borne and waterborne formulations. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers use it as a cure accelerator for silicone and polyurethane systems. By improving processing throughput, it provides significant efficiency gains. In plastics and polymer production, it serves as a catalyst or stabilizer additive during compounding and polymerization stages. Personal care formulators incorporate it as a pH buffer and preservative booster in emulsion systems. Sodium carboxylate salts provide compatibility with sensitive active ingredients in these specialized formulations. Sodium 2-ethylhexanoate is typically supplied as a liquid solution, with concentrations commonly ranging from 50% to 95% in water or hydrocarbon solvents depending on application requirements. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering for industrial coatings, adhesives, and polymer applications.
